name: Periodic Hill · Re 2800 · SST
description: Periodically driven turbulent channel over the standard hill profile, with DNS wall and velocity-profile data.

expectations.notes: Incompressible 2D SST approximation of spanwise-averaged DNS at Re_h=2800. Verify the measured crest bulk velocity before comparing profiles. Pressure has an arbitrary periodic offset.

sources.title: Balakumar: DNS/LES of separated periodic-hill flow
sources.notes: Reference DNS uses M=0.2 and spanwise averaging; this case solves incompressible 2D RANS.

comparisons.procedure: Cf=2 tau_wall/(rho Ub_crest²). Locate zero crossings to measure separation and reattachment; compare the lower-wall branch.
Align the arbitrary periodic pressure offset before comparing lower-wall Cp.
Evaluate the downstream lower-wall Cf zero crossing.
Compare U/Ub_crest at the X stations in the Tecplot profile file.
